name: Gas and flame detection
principle: Catalytic bead, infrared, electrochemical and ultrasonic sensors detect flammable and toxic gas; ultrasonic detectors hear leaks from pressurised gas.

process_steps.name: Sensor responds to gas or leak sound
Controller raises alarm and executes the cause and effect
